corrected_prompt:
Photoreal POV photo, vertical 9:16, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field. Look: a POV dramatization with hands only and never a face; a warm evening home office lit by a tungsten desk lamp from the left, soft shadows, natural skin; the hands always in a mustard-yellow knit sweater; muted warm palette of walnut, warm grey and mustard, the phone screen the brightest thing in the frame.
Reference images: none attached; this prompt is the only input.
Subject: one modern black smartphone with one lit screen and no second device, held upright by the viewer and facing the camera, left of centre (x 10% to 68% of the frame width) in the lower two thirds (y 34% to 96%), close to the camera; it appears once.
Hands: two adult hands seen from the viewer's own point of view, both wrists in mustard-yellow knit sleeves. The left hand holds the phone from below, four fingers around the lower back edge and the thumb on the left side. The right hand, at the lower right (x 70% to 98%, y 66% to 96%), holds one red ballpoint pen upright between thumb and index finger, cap off, tip pointing up, lifted about 5 cm above the desk and pulled back, not writing; the pen cap is not in the frame. No hand or pen covers any letter of the message. Exactly two hands with five fingers each.
Action: the left hand's fingers grip the phone's lower edge; the right thumb and index finger pinch the pen's barrel; the pen touches nothing.
Props: the phone is a plain black smartphone with thin bezels and rounded corners, no logo on the case or the glass. Its screen is lit and shows a plain chat view on a white background with exactly one large light-grey incoming message bubble near the top of the screen, aligned to the left, and empty white space below it; no names, no avatars, no status bar, no time, no app logo. The pen is a plain red ballpoint pen with no logo, about 22% of the frame height.
Text: inside the one grey bubble, in dark charcoal plain sans-serif, set large on 2 or 3 lines so it reads at phone size: "We found someone cheaper." Sentence case, exactly these words and punctuation. Both hands and the pen stay below and beside the bubble with clear space; every line ends well inside the bubble's edge; no letter touches a finger, thumb or sleeve.
Setting: a home office in the evening seen over the hands: a warm walnut desk below, soft and out of focus, a blurred mug at the right edge behind the pen hand, the wall behind dark warm grey and out of focus. No other screens, papers, posters or readable words anywhere.
Camera: first person looking down at the phone at about 30 degrees, phone screen sharp, 9:16. The top 32% of the frame is a calm, dark, out-of-focus wall with nothing in it. The right 13% holds only the pen hand, the desk and the blurred mug. The bottom 10% holds only the hands, the phone's lower edge and the desk.
Continuity: none, this is the first frame of the reel.
Negatives: no face and no reflection of a face in the screen; no logo, brand or app name; no numbers, no clock, no status bar; no words other than the message; nothing in the top 32% except the calm wall; no third hand; no second pen.
notes: The corrected prompt depends on the spec changes in qa/H-01-V7.spec.json (shorter string 'We found someone cheaper.', safe-zone wording, cap not in frame). Fix the spec first and re-run spec-check, then use this prompt (new prompt file and hash). It changes only the failed items. The producer's reasoning was not in the packet; the packet's note about the not-story-critical props was taken as a spec fact only.
